description.en: A weekly internet bundle: 2 GB of data valid for 7 days for 3,000 IQD.
description.ar: باقة انترنت أسبوعية: 2 جيجابايت صالحة لمدة 7 أيام مقابل 3,000 دينار عراقي.
description.ckb: پاکێجی ئینتەرنێتی هەفتانە: 2 گێگابایت بۆ ماوەی 7 ڕۆژ بە 3,000 دیناری عێراقی.
description.kmr: Pakêja înternetê ya hefteyî: 2 GB ji bo 7 rojan bi 3,000 dînarî.

subscribe.en: To subscribe, dial *321*2# or send NET2 to 1234.
subscribe.ar: للاشتراك، اطلب *321*2# أو أرسل NET2 إلى 1234.
subscribe.ckb: بۆ بەشداریکردن، *321*2# لێبدە یان NET2 بنێرە بۆ 1234.
subscribe.kmr: Ji bo aboneyê, *321*2# bigire yan NET2 bişîne bo 1234.

unsubscribe.en: To unsubscribe, send STOP NET2 to 1234.
unsubscribe.ar: لإلغاء الاشتراك، أرسل STOP NET2 إلى 1234.
unsubscribe.ckb: بۆ هەڵوەشاندنەوە، STOP NET2 بنێرە بۆ 1234.
unsubscribe.kmr: Ji bo betalkirinê, STOP NET2 bişîne bo 1234.

attributes.review_note: PLACEHOLDER entity — invented values and shortcodes; replace with a real weekly internet bundle (seed-20, docs/07 §9). ⚠ RETIRED 2026-09-12. Reason: a usefulness probe found the invented placeholders ranking #1 on 6 of 24 realistic customer questions and in the top 3 on 11 of 24 — they outranked the 50 real FEBRA bundles because they were the only entities with BOTH aliases and how_to, so they were the richest documents in the index. Worst observed case: "how do I subscribe to Weekly TikTok?" returned bundle_1603 subscribe at fused score 1.00, offering the INVENTED code "dial *321*2# or send NET2 to 1234". The invented Shukran definition was also the material a 3B model borrowed to fabricate a definition of "Eshrat Omar". Retired rather than deleted so the record and the gold-set history survive; `status: retired` is excluded from every query by buildFilter(). To bring one back, author it from a real source and set status accordingly. Weekly Net — entirely invented (name, price, shortcodes).
